title: Molecular dynamics and electronic structure insights into chloroquine, quercetin, and luteolin binding to HPV-16 E2 protein.
authors: Osailan, Raha; Habeeb, Talaat; Khalafalla, Mohammed A H; Bashal, Ali H
journal: The Journal of steroid biochemistry and molecular biology
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD和电子结构研究小分子配体与HPV-16 E2蛋白的结合，虽涉及蛋白-DNA复制功能区域，但对象为配体-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法聚焦于TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Human papillomavirus type 16 (HPV-16) E2 protein has key roles in the control of viral DNA replication. Small, biocompatible ligands with known antiviral activity and acceptable toxicity that bind to E2 and slightly change its motion may disturb these functions. In this study, we used 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations together with electronic-structure calculations to investigate how chloroquine, quercetin, and luteolin interact with E2. Analysis of protein motion (RMSD, Rg, and RMSF) showed that the protein remained stable, but ligand binding was linked to changes in the flexibility of residues near DNA-binding and other functional regions. All three ligands remained mainly near these regions during the simulations. Molecular Mechanics/Poisson-Boltzmann Surface Area (MM/PBSA) analysis supported stable binding, with quercetin showing the strongest estimated affinity. The HOMO-LUMO values and global reactivity descriptors were similar for the ligands, which may help explain their ability to settle in similar regions of E2. These findings suggest that the three ligands can influence functional areas of E2 and may indicate possible synergistic effects against protein-driven viral activity.
abstract_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒16型（HPV-16）E2蛋白在控制病毒DNA复制中具有关键作用。具有已知抗病毒活性和可接受毒性的小型生物相容性配体，若能与E2结合并轻微改变其运动，可能干扰这些功能。在本研究中，我们使用100纳秒分子动力学模拟结合电子结构计算，探讨氯喹、槲皮素和木犀草素如何与E2相互作用。蛋白质运动分析（RMSD、Rg和RMSF）显示蛋白质保持稳定，但配体结合与DNA结合区及其他功能区域附近残基灵活性的变化相关。在模拟过程中，所有三种配体主要停留在这些区域附近。分子力学/泊松-玻尔兹曼表面积（MM/PBSA）分析支持稳定结合，其中槲皮素显示出最强的估计亲和力。配体的HOMO-LUMO值和全局反应性描述符相似，这可能有助于解释它们在E2相似区域定位的能力。这些发现表明，三种配体可影响E2的功能区域，并可能提示对蛋白质驱动的病毒活性具有潜在的协同效应。
